author: yahyaatm
quote: When it comes to GTA 6, it honestly isn't worth the hype and is completely mediocre. Imagine it being 2026 and games are still launching at 30 FPS it’s an absolute disgrace. The real problem is the double standards almost everyone used to tear apart any game that launched at 30 FPS, yet with GTA 6, it’s suddenly fine just because it’s "story-driven and packed with details."As for the story, from what I’ve seen so far, the writing is weak—like it was written by a high school teenager. It’s stuffed with feminist agendas and every other kind of agenda imaginable. The main characters are terrible, completely soulless, and lack any charisma, while the game is overly filled with nudity and explicit **** gameplay itself is painfully average it's the exact same recycled formula Rockstar has been using in all their games since GTA 5. The only standout aspect of the game is the graphics and level of detail, and that’s simply not enough; graphics aren't the most important part ****. That's without even mentioning the $80 price tag, or the fact that it's the first major release to ditch physical discs, yet everyone is clapping and hyping it up as if nothing **** short, the game is very mediocre, and there are plenty of games out there that are much better. While opinions differ, anyone who calls this the "greatest game in history" has no clue what they're talking about. The biggest issue isn't even the game itself, it's the gaming community and content creators most of them have become like sheep, a mindless consumer audience that refuses to criticize anything anymore.
